posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
I'm glad that Adam and Christopher got to one of my questions. Was hoping that they'd do both, but one question per podcast is a good record, and my question got answered anyway.

I'm actually pretty happy with Naturalist's attitude in general. From my memory(which can be shakey at times, admitedly), lots of 'concervationist' themed heroes have a tendency to become really surly at some point during their comic run, like Animal Man. But Adam and Christopher don't really paint that kind of picture with Naturalist, he's mostly a guy who will commune with nature and such in his own book but won't turn a blind eye to a crisis that he could aid in stopping, and he's a believer in second chances. He never really goes full "Screw everyone, the earth is dying and we're all to blame" in the cardgame timeline. I just gotta say how much I love and appreciate the world that Adam and Christopher have made for us to play around in.

I'm curious, what do you guys think Naturalist's 2 new form's powers and effects would be if they were cards in his deck?
